title: Prison-wall escape tunnel diorama at night (4 glowing diggers)
summary: Night cut-away of earth under a prison wall: timbered gallery, rails, mine cart, cage lamps, 4 glowing men (pusher, map reader, 2 diggers), razor-wire wall, guard tower. Rolled solved camera.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.import: library_use({ id: 'recipe.recon.prison-wall-dig-diorama', as: 'dig' })   // -> scenes/dig.js + the modules it requires
usage.example: Merge settings.json theme + post (cap .95, ca 0) into project.json settings. Edit CONFIG (CAM, block/gallery dimensions, POSE per figure). ?marks=1 draws landmark spheres to prove the camera.

doc.when: Escape tunnels, smuggling tunnels, mines and excavations under a wall/border/building shown as a diorama block.
doc.avoid: Daylight without relighting (moon + front fill + warm practicals).
gotchas: ENGINE roll is -.114 = -(solver roll): the engine rotates after lookAt, the solver rotates image coordinates.
Figures are scaled 1.45-1.5: the AI reference draws people ~1.5x the structure. Scale per figure to its measured pixel height.
The track drifts toward the cut (railZ) as in the reference; rails are one mesh 10 cm tall so the cart counts as supported.
The tower leans -.09 about its ground edge to look plumb on screen under the rolled camera.
Hose, lamps and cables were back-projected onto the back plane (their 'physical' heights hid them behind the deck).

params.world: cut face z 0, ground top y 0, block x 0..22.3, gallery floor -4.34, deck underside -1.38

verify.changedPx: 0.5% (bare body instead of the user's mannequin, cart tub now textured)
